title: visualizer.render
description: Render a visualization. `intent` selects the template: 'mesh' (summoned mesh-topology overlay), 'dashboard' (always-present backdrop panels), 'lanes' (dev-lane panel), 'gaps' (capability-gap log overlay), 'agenda' (today/tomorrow calendar overlay). `args` is reserved for per-intent options (unused). Unknown intents return MeshDeny('unknown_intent').

args.description: Reserved per-intent options. Ignored in v1.
